sql: SELECT s.StoreKey AS StoreKey, s.StoreName AS StoreName, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales, sum(f.SalesAmount) / nullif(countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS AverageOrderValue, countDistinct(f.SalesOrderNumber) AS NumberOfTransactions FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f LEFT JOIN retail.DimStore s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey GROUP BY s.StoreKey, s.StoreName ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
